background_setting: A quiet suburban residential street lined with single-family homes, low fences, driveways, and mature trees casting dappled shadows onto the asphalt. Parked cars line the curb, hedges and manicured lawns border the sidewalks, and an unmarked crossing point cuts across the roadway ahead. The sky is clear blue with strong daylight, and the road surface shows subtle wear and consistent directional shadows.

lighting.direction: High sun, front-side lighting from the upper left
lighting.shadows: Crisp, consistent shadows cast to the lower right from trees, poles, and the crossing figures
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, high-contrast natural illumination with well-defined edges and warm midday tones

aesthetics.composition: Centered forward-facing ego perspective with the road receding to a vanishing point; the jogger and dog occupy the left-to-center midground crossing the lane, framed by parked cars and greenery
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm asphalt greys, green foliage, blue sky, with accents of the jogger's athletic clothing and the dog's tan coat
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating parked cars along the curb and rhythmic tree shadows across the road

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.focus: The jogger and dog crossing the lane and the road ahead

context: Autonomous vehicle perception and yielding scenario demonstrating group-linked pedestrian-and-animal detection at an unmarked crossing

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the residential street and detects a jogger with a large dog beginning to cross from the left, treating them as one linked group.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

The vehicle comes to a complete stop and remains fully stationary while both the jogger and dog finish crossing to the right; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

segments.description: Ego vehicle moves forward on the sunlit residential street; a jogger holding a large dog on a taut leash enters the lane from the left.
segments.key_changes: Crossing group appears and begins moving across the lane; vehicle speed still forward.
segments.camera: Forward motion at moderate speed with steady heading.

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.

segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The vehicle reaches a complete stop and remains stationary while the jogger and dog fully clear the crossing to the right. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle travels forward along the residential street and detects a jogger with a large dog beginning to cross from the left, treating them as one linked group. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient suburban daytime sound: gentle engine idle transitioning to a soft deceleration and brake, faint tire contact on asphalt, distant birdsong, light breeze, the rhythmic footfalls of the jogger, and a brief jingle of the dog's harness. No speech or music.
